what: daemon wiring for stored library trees (needs coordinator request for SectionId::SYNTAX_TREES + Image section Bytes helper first): at daemon start, open the image section SYNTAX_TREES with schema `base_db::trees::SCHEMA`, `base_db::trees::Trees::open(bytes)`; on Ok call `base_db::trees::install(Arc::new(trees))` before any Db is made (Db::new picks it up); on Err report the error (it names the section and versions) and start with no trees, never silently. In serve/image.rs Images::make add the section: `base_db::trees::write_section(&db, &mut out)` (out starting empty, 8-aligned). Report `db.trees().and_then(|t| t.failed())` when set: that image entry was refused and is not carried on. Also call `db.admit_parses()` once per revision (after applying file changes, before queries) so parse memos stay under the Parse tag budget of blaze-mem; it replaces the old `lru = 128`.
